subject: Finlytics POC: success criteria, timeline & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Finlytics POC: success criteria, timeline & next steps

Alex — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Recap / agreed goals:
- Primary objective: reduce inference latency for alert generation pipeline by 3x at 90th percentile while keeping quality on par with current model.
- Secondary objective: lower per-token cost by >=30% using batching/caching and quantized model variants.

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks):
- Setup: Redwood provides a dedicated eval instance (private tenant) and a sample endpoint for your staging data.
- Success criteria (initial): 90th percentile latency <120ms for 1-2k qps workload, precision/recall within 3% of baseline on the supplied eval set.
- Ownership: Redwood infra + Marcus (runtime lead) will provision the instance; Monica will own instrumentation and metrics; Alex/Priya will supply sample payloads and evaluation set.

Next steps / asks:
1) Alex: share the eval dataset and a short list of representative queries (can be pseudonymized) - target by EOD Thu 6/18.
2) Finlytics: confirm CI/CD access pattern we should use (SSH keys or temp S3 creds).
3) Redwood: we’ll provision the eval instance by 6/19 and schedule a 30-min kickoff on 6/21 to align on integration.

I’ve attached a one-page POC plan (redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf) and a suggested success criteria spreadsheet. If this looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for the kickoff.

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0117

Attachment: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf (1 page)
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finlytics.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finlytics.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC: success criteria, timeline & next steps

Thanks Marissa - this is excellent and aligns with our internal priorities. A few clarifications from our side:

- Evaluation data: Priya will share a pseudonymized sample payloads file and the baseline eval set by Thu 6/18 morning.
- Access: we prefer short-lived S3 creds for uploads; we will create an IAM role and a temp bucket for the POC.
- KPI nuance: for some longer-tail queries latency at 95th is more important; happy if we track both 90th and 95th during the run.

We’re good for the 6/21 kickoff - can you do 10:30am PT? Also, can you confirm whether Redwood will be able to push a small wrapper to our staging service (we’ll give a staging endpoint)?

Appreciate the plan - will review the attached spreadsheet and provide comments.

- Alex
Alex Turner
VP Product, Finlytics
alex.turner@finlytics.ai

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC: success criteria, timeline & next steps

Alex - perfect, 10:30am PT on 6/21 works for our team. Confirming the clarifications and next steps: 

- Data: Priya will upload eval set to the temp S3 bucket (we’ll share bucket ARN and temp creds once created).
- Tracking: we’ll report both 90th and 95th percentiles, plus precision/recall on your eval set.
- Integration: Redwood can push a lightweight wrapper; Marcus will scope the wrapper (container) and Rishi will handle any runtime config.

Internal ownership: Marcus (provisioning + wrapper), Monica (metrics + dashboards), Rishi (runtime tuning).

Action items assigned:
- Alex/Priya: upload eval assets by 6/18 EOD.
- Marcus: provision eval instance and share SSH + endpoint by 6/19.
- Monica: create a dashboard template and share link before kickoff.

I’ve scheduled the kickoff (calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finlytics-poc-kickoff). Attaching the success criteria spreadsheet for your review (finlytics-success-criteria.xlsx).

Thanks - looking forward.

Alex / Priya - quick weekly status and a nudge to keep the POC on schedule.

Status (this morning):
- Infra: Marcus has provisioned the eval instance and the wrapper image is built. Endpoint readiness blocked on your eval set being in the temp S3 bucket.
- Metrics: Monica has a dashboard template and will push live once data flows.
- Plan: Once we have the eval payloads we’ll run the initial 12-hour run and report back with 90th/95th latency and quality metrics.

Open asks (action required):

2) Confirm whether there are any special request headers or auth flow we should account for when calling your staging endpoint.

If helpful, we can do a 15-min sync tomorrow to walk through the S3 path and creds - Marcus and Monica will join. Otherwise we’ll plan to pick this up as soon as uploads are available.

Thanks - Marissa
